title: Affine local ideal of the zero locus
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M$ and $N$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\varphi:M\to N$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism. If $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is an affine open on which $M$ and $N$ have free generators $e_M$ and $e_N$, and $b\in A$ satisfies $\varphi(e_M)=b e_N$, then the ideal of $\varphi.zeroLocus$ on $U$ is $\operatorname{Ideal.span}\{b\}$.
